productAlreadyInFlashSale: Product is already in this flash sale
productInAnotherActiveFlashSale: Product is already in another active flash sale
productNotInFlashSale: Product is not in this flash sale
startTimeMustBeBeforeEndTime: Start time must be before end time
fixedDiscountExceedsPrice: Fixed discount cannot exceed original price
overlappingFlashSale: Only one flash sale can be active at a time. The time range overlaps with an existing flash sale.
productNoImages: Product must have at least one image
discountValueMustBePositive: Discount value must be greater than 0
